voice.rule: "the Firm" (PQE4.3: 56, we 0); the addressee is "the Client". "the Firm will provide" describes the services; "shall" binds (fees payable, acceptance).

cross_refs.rule: Annexure A (Scope Of Work), Annexure C (General And Specific Assumptions).

money.rule: Fees: USD [●]/- then (United States Dollars [words] Only), or PKR [●]/- (Pakistani Rupees [words] Only); net of tax stated.

cover.text: Proposal For The Provision Of Legal Advisory Services To [●] Relating To [●] / DATED: / Prepared For: / Prepared By:

opening.text: ALI KHAN LAW ASSOCIATES (the Firm) is pleased to submit this proposal dated [●] (this Proposal) to [●] (the Client) for an assignment (the Assignment) that entails the provision of legal advisory services … in connection with the Proposed Transaction (defined below).

scope.text: Subject to the Assumptions (defined below), the Firm will provide legal services as detailed in Annexure A (Scope Of Work) (the Services).

fees.text: Subject to the terms of this Proposal, including the assumptions set out in Annexure C (General And Specific Assumptions), … the Firm will charge its lump sum professional fees (the Professional Fees) … in the following amount, net of tax (the [●] Professional Fees Amount):

assumptions.text: This Proposal is subject to the specific and general assumptions detailed in Annexure C (General And Specific Assumptions) (the Assumptions).

limitation.text: The Firm’s total liability in a calendar year for all claims pursuant to and/or related to this Proposal is capped at the aggregate Professional Fees actually received by the Firm during such calendar year …

acceptance.text: The Firm welcomes any questions and is prepared to adjust this Proposal as needed. The Client may accept this Proposal by countersigning below and returning a copy to the Firm, whereupon this Proposal shall take effect on [●].

signature.text: Acknowledged and accepted by / For & On Behalf of / [Client] / Name: / Designation: / Date:; then Sincerely yours, / For & On Behalf of / Ali Khan Law Associates / [signing partner]
